svg.title: How Medical Summary Works
svg.desc: Input: 100 - 10,000 pages of medical records. Step 1, Filtering: LLM + Vision models analyze text and images to remove irrelevant pages. Step 2, Segmentation: LLM splits content into separate documents. Step 3, Summarization: LLM generates summary with references to original pages. Output: 60-70 pages with full history and source references.
